source: Ed4 C.6.5 and C.6.6, pp.C-71 to C-73; C.7.6.3, pp.C-120 to C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6
description: LOW-SPEED moves up to the estimate's target after a clean run on a higher received rung, not only on its own rung; MAX-SPEED still needs its own rung's run.
note: Table (corpus-format.md 6.1) as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run (probe_run null, every position on both walks). Flow as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run: conn 1 binds SAP 5; at 1000 to 3000 a burst holding a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 to us with CAPABILITY (Ed4 1), EOT 10, records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (C-1261); the request at 1500 queues "hello" for 0.0.1.3; at 52000 one transmission (WN 2 Long) holds the type 7 and 20 PADDING D_PDUs, all to 0.0.1.3, whose 21 EOWs are the top priority of Table C-25 (MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED), then SENDER-APPROACH 0xB04, then the rotation MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED, MAX-SEGMENT 0xAFF from its start (interp C-1260, C-1286). Earlier bursts (burst_started, bytes_received 30 ms later, burst_ended 60 ms later) hold a PADDING with EOT 0 (C-0105), or that PADDING and a type 7 to us whose data CRC fails (h = 1, e = 1: 1000 per thousand, over the 500 limit, C-0836). Codes: MAX-SPEED 0x8A0 + WN and LOW-SPEED 0x9A0 + WN at Long (C-0462, C-0469). Table positions: WN 2, 4, 6, 7 Long are 0 to 3; bulk thresholds on WN 4 Long -100, 0, 100, 150, on WN 7 Long -100, -50, 100, 400; latency on WN 2 Long -100, 100, 200, 400, on WN 4 Long -100, 100, 300, 400, on WN 7 Long -100, 0, 300, 600; smoothing weight 8, clean run 2, error limit 500 ppt, caps 2 doubling to 8. Bulk thresholds on WN 2 Long are -100, 50, 150, 300. P7-9 round 4 (corpus 0.37.0, interp C-1270): the clean run that backs a move up of LOW-SPEED may be that of the burst's rung when it is above LOW-SPEED, not only that of the rung at LOW-SPEED; MAX-SPEED is unchanged. At 100 a clean burst on WN 2 Long, estimate 450: S = 450; both targets are 3 (300 and 400), and the first recommendations are not above the rung received, WN 2 Long (position 0): MAX-SPEED and LOW-SPEED WN 2 Long. At 200 a clean burst on WN 4 Long, estimate 450: S = 450 on WN 4 Long; both targets 3 (150 and 400); MAX-SPEED needs 2 clean bursts on WN 2 Long, which has 1, and LOW-SPEED needs 2 on WN 2 Long or WN 4 Long, which have 1 each: both hold. The CAPABILITY burst, clean, on WN 4 Long, estimate 450: S stays 450, WN 4 Long's clean run is 2. MAX-SPEED: WN 2 Long's run is still 1, so it holds at WN 2 Long. LOW-SPEED: WN 4 Long is above it with a run of 2, so it moves straight to the target, WN 7 Long. Before corpus 0.37.0 it held at WN 2 Long until bursts at WN 2 Long came clean, which in a bulk exchange only short transmissions make. EOWs: 0x8A2, 0x9A7, 0xB04, then 0x8A2, 0x9A7, 0xAFF repeated, 21 in all; with the old rule 0x9A2 in place of 0x9A7.
